feedback: The candidate shows some progress improvement over the initial design but still fails to complete either the oval or s-bend tracks, terminating off track in both cases. The telemetry indicates persistent line loss events (2 per trial) and moderate RMS error (~0.022 to 0.024), with steering oscillation slightly reduced but still present. The increased base speed and proportional gain have improved forward progress (up to ~15% on s-bend) but control effort and oscillations remain notable, suggesting the controller is still not fully stable or responsive enough to maintain track. The integral gain reduction helped reduce overshoot but may have limited correction of steady-state errors. To improve, consider increasing kp slightly (e.g., to 1.1) to strengthen steering response, and slightly increase kd (e.g., to 0.06) to better damp oscillations. Also, try increasing ki moderately (e.g., to 0.12) to improve steady-state error correction without causing overshoot. These changes aim to enhance stability and tracking precision, reducing line loss events and improving completion likelihood. Confirm improvements by monitoring completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation in the next race.
